related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

outcome.basis: The new projection candidate makes the compiler session's declared-versus-selected repository mismatch and four outside-selected pointers visible in one explicitly hypothetical, traceable object. The focused ECI suite and the active compiler session's read-only projection query verify its shape and source classifications. It does not read compiler source through the unselected session, change checkout selection, establish that work was blocked, or establish recurrence.

improvement_relation.basis: The projection now emits a bounded context-pressure candidate separate from persisted pressure hypotheses, linking Work Intent scope, selected repositories, and exact outside-selected evidence references. Targeted tests and the live read-only compiler projection verify this behavior. No later compiler activity or independent agent use has been observed, so effectiveness remains unassessed.
not_measured: whether the context candidate changes subsequent compiler-agent actions
whether the checkout mismatch blocks or delays compiler development
whether similar scope gaps recur across sessions
empirical elimination of the workspace-selection pressure
independent later use of the context-pressure candidate
whether this observation enables previously impractical compiler work
